links.outcome: Patient acceptance and comfort after consultations using the ambient scribe
links.effect: 27 of 39 surveyed patients (69.2%) agreed their physician focused on them more during the consultation; none expressed discomfort with the technology.
links.quote: Patient acceptance was favorable: of 39 surveyed patients, 27 (69.2%) agreed that their physician focused on them more during the consultation, and none expressed discomfort with the technology.

screen.reason: Prospective time-motion observational study evaluating the deployment impact of an ambient AI scribe tool in real clinical consultations on documentation time, eye contact, and patient experience, comparing consultations with vs. without the tool.
